title: Case: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.
initial_request:
No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: DL-1049 displays delivered at 08:10 UTC today. We have not reviewed the handover record or route stop. Only the shipment and recipient account match are verified.

No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-024: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
